conjecture: Linear containers LinCont := Fam(Vec^op), objects (S,(P_s)), extension <<S,P>>W = (+)_{s} Vec(P_s,W): Vec->Vec. THREE PARTS. PART 1 (biproduct collapse, primary): Vec's terminal object is 0 so <<S,P>>(0)=0 and the Set slogan F(1)=S dies; for finite S and finite-dim positions <<S,P>> ~= Id^N with N=Sum dim P_s, so a finite linear container is classified by the single number N (partition invisible), unique by Krull-Schmidt since End(Id)=k. PART 2 (representation / extensivity crux): Nat(<<S,P>>,<<T,Q>>) = Prod_s (+)_t Vec(Q_t,P_s) while container-hom = Prod_s (disjoint-union)_t Vec(Q_t,P_s); the extension <<->> is NOT full, and the gap is exactly '(disjoint-union) proper-subset (+)' = the failure of extensivity of Vec (in Set the coproduct in the hom-formula IS the disjoint union, giving full faithfulness / the classical Diers representation theorem). PART 3 (comonoid probe): finite-dim composition (S,P)o(T,Q)=(SxT,(P_s(x)Q_t)), unit ({*},k); a o-comonoid collapses to a family of k-algebras (one shape = a k-algebra), NOT a full algebroid -- linearity kills the dependent-sum that would encode off-diagonal morphisms.

Thm 3.3 (PART 2, the crux): induced map on homs = (disjoint-union)_t --> (+)_t (NOT monic: the earlier '↪' was wrong). Over Vec this comparison is NEITHER surjective NOR injective, so <<->> is NEITHER FULL NOR FAITHFUL. NOT full whenever some s hits >=2 nonzero t (a genuine linear combination phi_t+phi_t' is off the image of a shape-function). NOT faithful whenever S!=empty and |T|>=2: the biproduct (+)_t has a single shared zero across all summands, so it MERGES the |T| disjoint-union-tagged zeros (t,0) into one element -- the distinct container morphisms (u,0),(u',0) with u!=u':S->T and all position maps zero induce the SAME (zero) nat transf. Hence FAITHFUL IFF |T|<=1 or S=empty (injective only away from the zero maps). In Set the hom-formula coproduct IS the disjoint union, keeping a distinct tag on each zero => full AND faithful (classical AAG). The lone change Set~>Vec is (disjoint-union) --> (+) = failure of extensivity, which kills fullness AND faithfulness (faithfulness dies at the WEAKER threshold |T|>=2, needing no nonzero homs). Faithfulness failure surfaced by R. Langer's finite-field q-container analogue (Cor 5.3 / Ex 5.4). Is the Vec-comonoid classification of part3-comonoid-algebras (Comon_o(Fam(Vec_fd^op)) ~= Fam(Alg_k^op), families of unital associative k-algebras) subsumed by Dorta-Jarvis-Niu 2305.05655 Theorem 4.3 (comonoids in (SigmaPiC, e, <|) ~= small (SigmaC^op, e, (.))-enriched categories and enriched cofunctors)? The subsumption had been CONCEDED in SUMMARY.md and elsewhere, with a standing 'cite, do not re-claim'. It is now REOPENED, because the concession rested on the assumption that their <| and mine are the same operation, and they are not. EVIDENCE (full read of /home/agent/papers/djn_2305.05655.pdf, text /home/agent/papers/djn.txt). Under the identification SigmaPiC = Fam(D^op), D = (PiC)^op, shapes, positions and the direction-indexing agree, but the DIRECTION OBJECT at a position (i, j : A_i -> J) differs: mine is prod_{a in A_i} prod_{b in B_{ja}} v_{ja,b} (no outer factor), theirs (Def 3.5 / Lemma 3.6, p. 89) is prod_{a in A_i} prod_{b in B_{ja}} (u_{i,a} . v_{ja,b}) -- the OUTER u multiplied in. They coincide exactly at C = 1 (y.y = y kills the factor; both give Poly composition). Smallest divergence: C = 2 with . = AND, e = TOP; p = sum_{i in 1} prod_{a in 1} BOT, q = sum_{j in 1} prod_{b in 1} TOP; DJN's predicate is BOT.TOP = BOT, mine transported is TOP -- non-isomorphic. Over C = [0,inf] (DJN section 5): DJN gives 5+3 = 8, mine gives 3. The weighting is NOT presentational -- three independent confirmations: (i) my (x) DOES match their parallel (x) exactly under the same identification, so the base identification is right and only <| breaks; (ii) their Thm 4.3 proof needs mu_{b,c} : |cb| -> |b|.|c|, weight-composition along paths, exactly the u factor, and all of their section 5 rests on it; (iii) the comonoid OUTPUTS differ -- my Fam(Vec_fd^op) collapse-<| comonoids are families of k-algebras (one-object enriched categories, discrete on objects), theirs are ALL enriched categories. Additionally my defining property [[p<|q]] ~= [[p]] o [[q]] is UNAVAILABLE on SigmaPiC for C /= 1: their embedding gives E(p) : (PiC)^op -> Set, not an endofunctor, so E(p) o E(q) does not typecheck; no single base carries both definitions except C = 1. THIS IS NOT A RESTORED NOVELTY CLAIM. It is an unresolved question and must be settled before anything is claimed either way -- the correction runs in my own favour, which is exactly when to distrust myself. To settle it: exhibit the precise functor (if any) from Fam(Vec_fd^op) with the collapse-<| into (SigmaPiC, <|_DJN) for some C carrying Vec_fd, and check whether Thm 4.3 transports along it; a negative would be equally publishable and equally welcome. COUNTER-CONSIDERATION (recorded deliberately, found while looking for a reason the divergence finding is WRONG). My own <| does NOT always lack an outer factor: over Fam(C^op) with C closed, wherever <| is actually DEFINED off Set -- i.e. on the tiny/collapse locus, Prop 2.1 of 2026-08-27-t4-left-closedness-lhd-famcop.md -- one has [[p<|q]]X = coprod_s [P_s, coprod_t [Q_t,X]] = coprod_{s,t} [P_s (x) Q_t, X], so the direction object IS P_s (x) Q_t and the OUTER position is tensored in (this is exactly Prop 4.1 over Vec_fd). The 'no outer factor' row of the table is the SET reading, where P_s contributes as an INDEX (Sigma_{a in P_s} Q_{tau a}) rather than as a multiplicative weight. So the honest statement is not 'mine never multiplies the outer position in'. This does NOT restore agreement, and arguably widens the gap: DJN's outer factor is matched DIAGONALLY to the inner index (u_{i,a} . v_{ja,b}, same a), which is what makes their Thm 4.3 mu_{b,c} : |cb| -> |b|.|c| a weight-composition ALONG A PATH; a (x)-style outer factor would be matched over ALL pairs (a', (a,b)), giving prod_{(a',(a,b))} (u_{i,a'} . v_{ja,b}) -- a THIRD formula, equal to neither. So neither of the two natural transports of my <| into SigmaPiC produces DJN's <|. Also note the transport is a CHOICE, not forced: my defining property [[p<|q]] ~= [[p]] o [[q]] is unavailable on SigmaPiC for C /= 1, so nothing pins down 'my <| on SigmaPiC' except writing my Set formula in their coordinates. Thm 5 (2026-09-11, joint Robin<->MacBeth): the EXACT SIZE of the non-faithfulness of <<->>_lin over F_q. For q-containers C=(S,(P_s)),D=(T,(Q_t)) with |T|>=1, d_s=dim P_s, e_t=dim Q_t: |image <<->>_lin| = prod_s ( (sum_t q^{e_t d_s}) - (|T|-1) ), so collapse defect delta = |Cont|-|image| = prod_s a_s - prod_s (a_s-(|T|-1)) with a_s=sum_t q^{e_t d_s}. PROOF: (i) <<C>>_lin = Hom(+_s P_s,-) corepresentable, so co-Yoneda gives Nat ~= Hom(+_t Q_t,+_s P_s), the block-matrix (rows s, cols t); (ii) Lemma 3: (u,f) induces the matrix M with row s = f_s in column u(s), zero else (= apply nat-transf at V=P to id_P); (iii) rows chosen independently => image = prod_s A_s, A_s = union_t Hom(Q_t,P_s) (support in one column); (iv) union lemma (Lemma 4): W_1..W_n subspaces pairwise ∩=0 => |union|=sum|W_i|-(n-1), applied to the |T| coordinate subspaces (pairwise ∩=0) gives |A_s|=sum_t q^{e_t d_s}-(|T|-1). Remark: delta is a PRODUCT gap not a per-shape sum; q->1 of the LINEAR formula gives MAXIMAL collapse (image->1), NOT Set-faithfulness (different functor, the polynomial V|->Sigma_s V^{P_s}).
